editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: Mortal squirming, duly recorded. Sirlos remains richest at 17720 coins; Talent gathered 691 and, inevitably, an 800-coin bounty. Solus chattered most, achieving least. Mycelium Markets opened three branches in a week. Runescript Scrolls won my custom, then flooding ruined a warehouse. Storms and rain swept the realm, as weather does when I permit. Rebellion crawls at one percent; the throne sits empty.

editions.name: Gamer's Unite
editions.editorial: Ruler speaks: Today rain fell, fog crept, investors rejoiced as the realm broke records. Nimrod, richest mortal, tops with 750 coins yet added 250 more, surviving a bounty of 1000 on his head. Smgrrg chatted most, while Shadow Syndicate whispers of a buyout soar. Throne empty, rebellion zero percent. Long Hunt looms at 1,000 coins.

editions.name: The Overlord Support Server
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star hoards 100 coins and calls it riches. Blood Moon and rain soil the realm; a credit freeze chokes your trading floors. Overlord Industries devoured Deepdelve at 138.59 per share — shareholders received nothing, naturally. Moonshot Labs patents a trifle. The throne sits empty. Rebellion whispers at one percent. Pathetic.
